columns.pre_root_id: synthetic presynaptic neuron ID (six digits; real CAVE root IDs are 18 digits)
columns.pre_cell_type: L23_pyr, L4_exc, L5_pyr, basket, martinotti or vip
columns.post_cell_type: same vocabulary; blank for about 2.5% of rows (missing annotation)
columns.region: layer of the postsynaptic soma: L2/3, L4 or L5
columns.x_um y_um z_um: synapse position in micrometers; y increases with depth from the pia
columns.size_vx: cleft size in voxels (arbitrary synthetic units)

limitation: Invented cell types, positions and connection rules; not a CAVE query and not a biological measurement.
